alcaraz_matches_2024.question: How many matches did Carlos Alcaraz play in 2024?
alcaraz_matches_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM matches JOIN players AS p1 ON matches.player1_id = p1.player_id JOIN players AS p2 ON matches.player2_id = p2.player_id JOIN tournaments ON matches.tournament_id = tournaments.tournament_id WHERE tournaments.year = 2024 AND ((p1.first_name = 'Carlos' AND p1.last_name = 'Alcaraz') OR (p2.first_name = 'Carlos' AND p2.last_name = 'Alcaraz')) LIMIT 1000

sinner_wins_2024.question: How many matches did Jannik Sinner win in 2024?
sinner_wins_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_won_2024 FROM matches JOIN players ON matches.winner_id = players.player_id WHERE players.first_name = 'Jannik' AND players.last_name = 'Sinner' AND matches.match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND matches.match_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000

italian_players.question: How many players in the database are from Italy?
italian_players.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS italian_players_count FROM players WHERE nationality = 'ITA' LIMIT 1000

djokovic_clay_wins.question: How many matches did Novak Djokovic win on clay between 2023 and 2025?
djokovic_clay_wins.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_won_on_clay FROM matches AS m JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE p.first_name = 'Novak' AND p.last_name = 'Djokovic' AND t.surface = 'clay' AND t.year >= 2023 AND t.year <= 2025 LIMIT 1000

us_open_five_setters_2024.question: How many five-set matches were played at the 2024 US Open?
us_open_five_setters_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS five_set_match_count FROM matches AS m JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id WHERE t.name ILIKE '%US Open%' AND t.year = 2024 AND m.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM sets GROUP BY match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 5) LIMIT 1000

alcaraz_sinner_h2h.question: What's the head-to-head record between Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner?
alcaraz_sinner_h2h.sql: WITH players_ids AS (SELECT player_id, first_name, last_name FROM players WHERE (first_name = 'Carlos' AND last_name = 'Alcaraz') OR (first_name = 'Jannik' AND last_name = 'Sinner')), matches_between AS (SELECT winner_id FROM matches WHERE (player1_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM players_ids) AND player2_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM players_ids))) SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM matches_between AS m JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.first_name, p.last_name LIMIT 10

top5_wins_2024.question: Who are the top 5 players by number of match wins in 2024?
top5_wins_2024.sql: SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(m.match_id) AS wins FROM players AS p JOIN matches AS m ON p.player_id = m.winner_id WHERE m.match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 5

most_clay_wins_2025.question: Which player won the most matches on clay in 2025?
most_clay_wins_2025.sql: SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(m.match_id) AS wins FROM matches AS m JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE t.surface = 'clay' AND t.year = 2025 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1

sinner_ranking_2024.question: Show Jannik Sinner's ranking trend over 2024.
sinner_ranking_2024.sql: SELECT rh.ranking_date, rh.rank, rh.points FROM rankings_history AS rh JOIN players AS p ON rh.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.first_name = 'Jannik' AND p.last_name = 'Sinner' AND rh.ranking_date >= '2024-01-01' AND rh.ranking_date < '2025-01-01' ORDER BY rh.ranking_date LIMIT 100

sinner_weeks_at_no1_2024.question: In how many weekly rankings during 2024 was Jannik Sinner ranked number 1?
sinner_weeks_at_no1_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS weeks_ranked_1 FROM rankings_history AS rh JOIN players AS p ON rh.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.first_name = 'Jannik' AND p.last_name = 'Sinner' AND rh.rank = 1 AND rh.ranking_date >= '2024-01-01' AND rh.ranking_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000

three_titles_2025.question: Which players won at least 3 tournaments in 2025?
three_titles_2025.sql: SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.tournament_id) AS tournaments_won FROM players AS p JOIN matches AS m ON p.player_id = m.winner_id JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id WHERE t.year = 2025 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.tournament_id) >= 3 LIMIT 100

medvedev_losses_followup.question: Now just the ones he lost.
medvedev_losses_followup.sql: SELECT m.match_id, m.tournament_id, m.player1_id, m.player2_id, m.winner_id, m.match_date, m.round FROM matches AS m JOIN players AS p ON (m.player1_id = p.player_id OR m.player2_id = p.player_id) WHERE p.first_name = 'Daniil' AND p.last_name = 'Medvedev' AND m.match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2025-01-01' AND m.winner_id <> p.player_id LIMIT 100

injuries_naming_trap.question: Which players have had an injury lasting more than 30 days?
injuries_naming_trap.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name FROM players AS p JOIN injuries AS i ON p.player_id = i.player_ref WHERE (i.end_date - i.start_date) > 30 LIMIT 100
